fact.claim: If rotation is on for a primary secret, Secrets Manager rotates it in the primary Region and the new value propagates to all replica secrets; you do not manage rotation for each replica.
fact.question: Where does rotation run for a replicated secret, and how do replicas get the new value?

values.display: rotates the secret in the primary Region
propagates to all of the associated replica secrets

qualifiers.condition: rotation turned on for the primary secret

evidence.quote: If you turn on rotation for your primary secret, Secrets Manager rotates the secret in the primary Region, and the new secret value propagates to all of the associated replica secrets. You don't have to manage rotation individually for all of the replica secrets.
evidence.title: Replicate AWS Secrets Manager secrets across Regions

fact.author: mine-07-behavior+decisions

votes.reason: Quote states rotation happens in the primary Region, the value propagates to all replicas, and replicas need no individual rotation.
